title: Nested .gitignore negations can never re-include what an ancestor excluded
author: KaizenShogun
body_preview: **Describe the bug**  A negation in a nested `.gitignore` can never re-include something an ancestor `.gitignore` excluded. Git decides the other way round: the *deepest* gitignore file that has a matching pattern wins, and only inside that file does last-match-win.
